import pytest
from inventory import Inventory


def make():
    inv = Inventory(low_stock_threshold=5)
    inv.add("B2", "Bolt", 10, 0.5, ["hardware", "steel"])
    inv.add("A1", "Apple", 5, 1.25, ["food"])
    inv.add("C3", "Cable", 2, 7.0)
    return inv


def test_add_increases_qty():
    inv = make()
    inv.add("A1", "Apple", 3, 9.99)
    assert inv.get("A1").qty == 8
    assert inv.get("A1").price == 1.25


def test_total_value():
    assert make().total_value() == round(10 * 0.5 + 5 * 1.25 + 2 * 7.0, 2)


def test_remove_insufficient_raises():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        make().remove("C3", 3)


def test_tags_not_shared_between_items():
    inv = Inventory()
    a = inv.add("X", "x", 1, 1.0)
    b = inv.add("Y", "y", 1, 1.0)
    a.tags.append("only-x")
    assert b.tags == []


def test_remove_to_zero_keeps_item():
    inv = make()
    inv.remove("C3", 2)
    assert inv.get("C3") is not None
    assert inv.get("C3").qty == 0


def test_low_stock_includes_threshold():
    inv = make()
    assert inv.low_stock() == ["A1", "C3"]


def test_search_case_insensitive_and_tags():
    inv = make()
    assert [i.sku for i in inv.search("apple")] == ["A1"]
    assert [i.sku for i in inv.search("STEEL")] == ["B2"]


def test_page_is_one_indexed():
    inv = make()
    assert [i.sku for i in inv.page(1, 2)] == ["A1", "B2"]
    assert [i.sku for i in inv.page(2, 2)] == ["C3"]

import pytest
from inventory import Inventory


def test_add_rejects_nonpositive_qty():
    inv = Inventory()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        inv.add("A", "a", 0, 1.0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        inv.add("A", "a", -1, 1.0)


def test_get_unknown_returns_none():
    assert Inventory().get("missing") is None


def test_remove_unknown_raises_keyerror():
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        Inventory().remove("missing", 1)


def test_tags_independent_from_argument():
    inv = Inventory()
    shared = ["x"]
    a = inv.add("A", "a", 1, 1.0, shared)
    b = inv.add("B", "b", 1, 1.0, shared)
    a.tags.append("only-a")
    assert b.tags == ["x"]
    assert shared == ["x"]


def test_low_stock_sorted_and_includes_threshold():
    inv = Inventory(low_stock_threshold=3)
    inv.add("C", "c", 3, 1.0)
    inv.add("A", "a", 1, 1.0)
    inv.add("B", "b", 4, 1.0)
    assert inv.low_stock() == ["A", "C"]


def test_total_value_rounded():
    inv = Inventory()
    inv.add("A", "a", 3, 0.1)
    assert inv.total_value() == 0.3


def test_search_name_or_tag_case_insensitive():
    inv = Inventory()
    inv.add("B", "Bolt", 1, 1.0, ["Steel"])
    inv.add("A", "Apple", 1, 1.0, ["food"])
    assert [i.sku for i in inv.search("bolt")] == ["B"]
    assert [i.sku for i in inv.search("steel")] == ["B"]
    assert [i.sku for i in inv.search("foo")] == ["A"]


def test_page_past_end_empty_and_sorted():
    inv = Inventory()
    inv.add("B", "b", 1, 1.0)
    inv.add("A", "a", 1, 1.0)
    inv.add("C", "c", 1, 1.0)
    assert [i.sku for i in inv.page(1, 2)] == ["A", "B"]
    assert [i.sku for i in inv.page(2, 2)] == ["C"]
    assert inv.page(3, 2) == []
